Definition: Jeish, the name of an Edomite and of a an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Jeush = "assembler"; 1) son of Esau by Aholibamah the daughter of Anah, son of Zibeon the Hivite; 2) a Benjamite, son of Bilhan
